dict.string: OWMB requires access to your Desktop to scan and load audio samples.
OWMB requires access to your Documents folder to scan and load audio samples.
OWMB requires access to your Downloads folder to scan and load audio samples.
OWMB requires access to external drives and removable volumes to scan and load audio sample libraries.
OWMB requires access to network volumes to scan and load audio sample libraries.
OWMB requires microphone access for audio sample recording.
